description: This file contains implementation of image convolution functions, including horizontal and vertical convolution routines, filter setup, and SIMD optimizations for the skia graphics library. It defines classes and functions for applying convolution filters to image data, with support for different CPU architectures.

classes.name: CircularRowBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a circular buffer of image rows for convolution processing.

classes.name: ConvolutionFilter1D
classes.description: A class representing a one-dimensional convolution filter, supporting addition of filter coefficients and retrieval of filter data.

methods.name: ClampTo8
methods.description: Converts an integer to an 8-bit unsigned value with clamping to 0-255.

methods.name: BringBackTo8
methods.description: Converts accumulated convolution result back into 8-bit range, optionally taking absolute value.

methods.name: ConvolveHorizontally
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on a single image row, templated on presence of alpha channel.

methods.name: ConvolveVertically
methods.description: Performs vertical convolution to produce one output row, templated on presence of alpha channel.

methods.name: BGRAConvolve2D
methods.description: Performs 2D convolution on BGRA image data with optional SIMD acceleration.

methods.name: SingleChannelConvolveX1D
methods.description: Applies a 1D convolution filter horizontally on a single image channel.

methods.name: SingleChannelConvolveY1D
methods.description: Applies a 1D convolution filter vertically on a single image channel.

methods.name: SetUpGaussianConvolutionKernel
methods.description: Sets up a Gaussian or derivative convolution kernel based on sigma.
